table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	INV_NO=S.SALEINVCODE, 
	INV_DATE=S.DATE, 
	CUSTCODE=A.aliasname, 
	CUSTNAME=A.NAME, 
	PROD_CODE=I.CUSTOMICODE, 
	ITEMNAME=I.NAME, 
	PACK_SIZE=I.PACKINGDESC, 
	SL.BATCH,  
	SL.EXPIRY, 
	SL.LOOSEQTY, 
	SL.BONUSQTY, 
	SL.DISCPERC, 
	SL.SALEPRICE,
	UserName=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = S.SalesmanCode)
FROM 
	SALELEDGER S, 
	SALEDETAIL SL, 
	ITEM I, 
	ACCOUNTS A
WHERE 
	S.SALEINVCODE = SL.SALEINVCODE AND 
	S.CUSTCODE = A.ACCCODE AND 
	SL.ICODE = I.ICODE AND
	I.MANFCODE = :ai_manfcode AND 
	S.DATE BETWEEN :ad_StartDATE AND :ad_EndDATE
ORDER BY  
	S.DATE,
	S.SALEINVCODE,
	I.NAME,
	SL.BATCH, 
	SL.EXPIRY
table.sort: inv_date A, inv_no A, itemname A, prod_code A, batch A, expiry A

props.names: inv_date	inv_no	custcode	custname	itemname	prod_code	pack_size	batch	expiry
